qa_pairs.question: An active OrbitPlus member opened a standard device. Does membership extend the return period, and is there a restocking fee?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. OrbitPlus does not extend the 14-day opened-device window. An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and has a 10% restocking fee unless the device is verified defective during the return window.

contexts.text: OrbitPlus extends the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days for eligible purchases made while membership is active. It does not extend the 14-day opened-device window, override hygiene exclusions, or extend a product warranty. Members may receive a loaner during some covered repairs under `07_repair_and_technical_support.md`, subject to availability and a refundable deposit.

For orders placed on or after September 1, 2026, an unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery. An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee. A defective device verified during the return window is not charged a restocking fee. OrbitPlus may extend only the unopened-device window as described in `03_promotions_and_membership.md`.

qa_pairs.question: A customer placed an OrbitTech order on August 25, 2026, joined OrbitPlus after ordering, and wants to return an unopened device. Which return-policy version and window apply?

qa_pairs.expected_answer: Liquid exposure is excluded from the warranty, although accidental damage may be repairable for a fee. contexts.text: The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider. It also excludes failures caused solely by third-party networks, applications, accessories, or compatibility changes.

A customer inside the return window may choose an eligible return; after that window, a covered defect follows the repair process in `07_repair_and_technical_support.md`.
